subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Mondstadt's side gate to look for Plauen

705280401.text: *sigh* Can the Guild really manage this amount of work...

705280402.text: Ah, Traveler! My apologies for not noticing you sooner. I had some Guild affairs on my mind...

705280403.text: You must be here in Mondstadt for the Windblume Festival, I presume?

705280404.text: You're just in time: The Guild has just come up with a little game — a guaranteed romp with prizes to be won!

705280405.text: How about it? Wanna give it a go?

705280406.text: Let me introduce this little game to you first. The person who designed it calls it "Floral Chess."

705280407.text: He said that his inspiration came from the billowing petals and the wind that pursues them...

705280408.text: And the game is meant to imitate the... romanticism of pursuing these flower petals...

705280411.text: Well, this inventor is a bard, so he has more of... You know, an imagination.

705280412.text: Basically, when you're playing this form of chess, you need to collect as many Bloom Balloons within the chessboard as possible.

705280413.text: You'll have to avoid various obstacles in the process... and there'll be some tools on hand to lend you some support...

705280414.text: That fellow even wrote an entire manual for this game, which I'll let you have a look at later.

705280415.text: If you're interested, you're welcome to play. Remember, prizes are guaranteed just for participating!
